children: Robinhood this quarter said that working with Rothera, the prediction market in which it owns a stake, has helped it to make a more dynamic pricing model for contracts. "Flash Heard: Why Prediction Markets Are So Lucrative for Robinhood — WSJ," at 3:44pm ET,  mistakenly referred to Rothera as Robinhood's "own" market.
